biotools.summary: ChloroDBPFinder is an R package that utilizes machine learning to recognize chlorinated disinfection byproducts (Cl-DBPs) from nontargeted LC-HRMS analysis. The tool provides a solution for identifying Cl-containing compounds in water samples and is freely available on GitHub.
